# IM Capabilities

The matrix is generated from `spec/im-application-platform.json` and checked by the complete-app gate.

## Coverage

Conversation · Message · Reply · Reaction · Thread · Forward · Search · Contacts · Groups · Media · Calls.

## Status

`Supported` means public API, contract, and tests exist. `Partial` is a documented P2/P3 platform difference. `Host` means the host provides SDK, network, RTC, push, or persistence.

## Boundary

The kit emits intents and renders controlled state. It does not bind Vue Router, Navigator, Android Navigation, Swift NavigationStack, or an IM SDK.
